title: Making It Bipartite
statementMd:
You are given an undirected graph of $n$ vertices indexed from $1$ to $n$, where vertex $i$ has a value $a_i$ assigned to it and all values $a_i$ are **different**. There is an edge between two vertices $u$ and $v$ if either $a_u$ divides $a_v$ or $a_v$ divides $a_u$.

Find the minimum number of vertices to remove such that the remaining graph is bipartite, when you remove a vertex you remove all the edges incident to it.

## Input

The input consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains a single integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$) — the number of test cases. Description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 5\cdot10^4$) — the number of vertices in the graph.

The second line of each test case contains $n$ integers, the $i$-th of them is the value $a_i$ ($1 \le a_i \le 5\cdot10^4$) assigned to the $i$-th vertex, all values $a_i$ are **different**.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $5\cdot10^4$.

## Output

For each test case print a single integer — the minimum number of vertices to remove such that the remaining graph is bipartite.

## Note

In the first test case if we remove the vertices with values $1$ and $2$ we will obtain a bipartite graph, so the answer is $2$, it is impossible to remove less than $2$ vertices and still obtain a bipartite graph.

BeforeAfter![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a8d2ee247a91514d62d2e5a4a5b13b958734cf2c.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7c9e404c8ec23f1f4df843a0d50c31986a9f09f.png) test case #1

In the second test case we do not have to remove any vertex because the graph is already bipartite, so the answer is $0$.

BeforeAfter![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f507c8b5568074fce8540e6ffc9cf21c806db461.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99cb9a76bd59c6f883cd64081886dcac92cb7664.png) test case #2

In the third test case we only have to remove the vertex with value $12$, so the answer is $1$.

BeforeAfter![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b2fbf26f11346240d6f4c895b181a43cd158d5.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7104c16c22c531b3f1b2695944e8c01ab44ffe60.png) test case #3

In the fourth test case we remove the vertices with values $2$ and $195$, so the answer is $2$.

BeforeAfter![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c613c9d1c863075686bade66813fc20aec86e32e.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/746366998f143a99e20d4c7363e577716f2f9f9b.png) test case #4
statementZhMd:
给定一个包含 $n$ 个顶点的无向图，顶点编号从 $1$ 到 $n$。顶点 $i$ 被赋予一个值 $a_i$，且所有值 $a_i$ **互不相同**。当且仅当 $a_u$ 整除 $a_v$ 或 $a_v$ 整除 $a_u$ 时，顶点 $u$ 和顶点 $v$ 之间存在一条边。

求最少需要删除多少个顶点，才能使剩余图成为二分图。删除一个顶点时，与该顶点相连的所有边也会被删除。

## 输入格式

输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——测试用例的数量。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 5\cdot10^4$）——图中顶点的数量。

每组测试用例的第二行包含 $n$ 个整数，其中第 $i$ 个整数为赋予第 $i$ 个顶点的值 $a_i$（$1 \le a_i \le 5\cdot10^4$），所有值 $a_i$ **互不相同**。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $5\cdot10^4$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数——使剩余图成为二分图所需删除的最少顶点数。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，如果删除值为 $1$ 和 $2$ 的顶点，得到的图将是二分图，因此答案为 $2$。不可能只删除少于 $2$ 个顶点并使得到的图成为二分图。

删除前后![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a8d2ee247a91514d62d2e5a4a5b13b958734cf2c.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7c9e404c8ec23f1f4df843a0d50c31986a9f09f.png) 测试用例 #1

在第二个测试用例中，无需删除任何顶点，因为图本身已经是二分图，所以答案为 $0$。

删除前后![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f507c8b5568074fce8540e6ffc9cf21c806db461.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99cb9a76bd59c6f883cd64081886dcac92cb7664.png) 测试用例 #2

在第三个测试用例中，只需删除值为 $12$ 的顶点，因此答案为 $1$。

删除前后![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b2fbf26f11346240d6f4c895b181a43cd158d5.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7104c16c22c531b3f1b2695944e8c01ab44ffe60.png) 测试用例 #3

在第四个测试用例中，删除值为 $2$ 和 $195$ 的顶点，因此答案为 $2$。

删除前后![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c613c9d1c863075686bade66813fc20aec86e32e.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/746366998f143a99e20d4c7363e577716f2f9f9b.png) 测试用例 #4
